purpose: Replicate the qualified Qwen3.8 Q8_0 TP2 active-context curve and add a fail-closed server-reported prompt-evaluation throughput profile.

metrics.decode: 99 inter-token intervals after TTFT over 128 returned token IDs
metrics.ttft: HTTP request start to first returned token
metrics.prefill: llama-server prompt eval tokens per second for the exact submitted prompt; parsed only when the log reports one exact timing row for every registered depth
metrics.workload_grade: C repeated-token exact-shape fixture; not natural prose

required_gates: ordinary and O_DIRECT model hashes match before launch
server, SYCL backend, fixture, and benchmark harness hashes match
all six exact-depth receipts pass the token-count, 128-token, cache-zero, no-truncation, and no-context-shift gates
server log contains exactly one prompt-evaluation timing for each registered depth and no registered depth is missing

publication.zero_context_point: not measured and must remain absent
